description: This Dart source file defines a FakeDownloadEngine class that implements a download simulation for testing purposes. It manages timers to simulate download progress, allowing start, cancel, and cancel all operations.

classes.name: FakeDownloadEngine
classes.description: A mock implementation of DownloadEngine that simulates download progress using timers.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a simulated download, periodically updating progress via onProgress callback.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing simulated download by contentId.

methods.name: cancelAll
methods.description: Cancels all active simulated downloads, primarily used in testing to prevent timers from keeping the isolate alive.
